high_level_description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman, walking together outdoors. The man is on the left side of the frame, wearing a brown t-shirt and matching brown pants. He has sunglasses on and is waving with his right hand, which is adorned with a bracelet and a ring. His expression appears cheerful and relaxed. The woman is on the right side of the frame, dressed in a black off-the-shoulder dress with ruffled sleeves and a wide-brimmed straw hat. She is also wearing sunglasses and has her hair styled down.
